{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column to understand the format
print(sales_df['revenue'].unique())

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print(sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Check the first few rows to confirm the conversion
print(sales_df[['revenue']].head())"}
